obj.beli: Mampir ke warung Mak Yah. Dengar gosip warga soal kebakaran dan Joy.
obj.pulang: Cukup untuk malam ini. Kembali ke rumah.

joy.1: Eh, Raka! Kapan kau pulang? Aku belum sempat menyapamu waktu bis tadi lewat.
joy.2: Aku ke ladang dulu, bawa karung sama senter. Nanti aku lewat sini lagi. Senandung dulu, ya, jalan ini sepi.

mak_yah.1: Eh, si Raka! Kapan pulang, Nak? Udah gede kau ya sekarang.
mak_yah.2: Duduklah di situ. Mau nasi bungkus, teh panas, atau cuma dengar gosip orang tua?
mak_yah.c1: Tanya soal titik api bulan ini.

kembali.1: Ada lagi, Nak? Anggap saja gosip.

b05.tekan: Desak sedikit. Siapa tahu ada yang kelewat.

topik_a.1: Kebakaran? Yang bulan ini bukan di sini, Nak. Titik api di ladang sebelah hutan, bukan ladang Joy.
topik_a.2: Warga bilang asapnya kelihatan dua malam. Tidak ada yang luka, cuma rumput habis. Itu sebelum kau pulang.
topik_a.3: Sudah segitu ceritanya. Mau tahu lagi?

tekan.1: Yang lihat bilang cuma semburat merah di balik pohon. Besok paginya sudah hitam semua.
tekan.2: Jam berapa tidak ada yang pasti. Orang lebih suka tidur daripada jadi saksi.

topik_b.1: Joy itu penjaga ladang titipan keluarga. Tinggal sendirian di pondok dekat hutan.
topik_b.2: Bukan hilang, Nak. Cuma memang jarang keluar. Ayahnya sakit di kota, dia disuruh jagu ladang.
topik_b.3: Suka bersenandung sambil kerja. Kalau malam begini, pasti dia sudah di ladang.

tekan.1: Kubilang sama dia, tinggal di pinggir hutan begitu kasihan. Dia cuma ketawa.
tekan.2: Katanya dia senang sendiri. Ya sudah, Nak, biarkan dia.

topik_c.1: Orang baru? Minggu ini ada mobil hitam berhenti dekat warung. Dua orang, jaket tebal, tidak kenal siapa siapa.
topik_c.2: Mereka minta jalan ke kebun, bayar pakai uang kertas baru. Pak Rudi yang nemeni.
topik_c.3: Sudah, sudah. Makan dulu, Nak, sebelum nasinya dingin.

tekan.1: Katanya disuruh jaga malam di kebun. Bayarannya per malam, langsung tunai.
tekan.2: Aku cuma dengar dari orang lain. Kau tanya langsung ke Pak Rudi, nanti dia marah.

selesai.1: Sudah pulang kamu, Nak. Hati-hati di jalan, malam ini gelap.
selesai.2: Lain kali singgah. Jangan cuma datang waktu mau nanya.

nasi.1: Aku duduk di bangku dekat pintu. Pesan makanan dulu, biar tidak kelihatan mengawasi.

a.1: Ayam. Nanti kubagi porsi besar, kasihan kurus kau.

b.1: Nasi kuning. Kau masih suka yang ini, ya.

c.1: Teh panas. Uangmu simpan dulu, kau bayar besok.

warga.1: Dua orang di meja ujung bicara pelan. Sesekali mereka menoleh ke arahku.
warga.2: Makan sudah, Ri? Jangan pulang sendirian, jalan dekat kebun itu gelap.

radio.1: Kering berkepanjangan sampai akhir bulan. Warga diminta tidak membakar sampah di pinggir lahan.
radio.2: Radio warung selalu terlalu keras. Malam ini suaranya sampai ke jalan.

keluar.1: Aku berdiri di pintu warung. Di kejauhan, lampu ladang menyala satu per satu.
keluar.2: Malam ini cukup. Aku pulang sebelum pikiran jalan sendiri.

obj.beli: Stop by Mak Yah's warung. Listen to the villagers talk about the fire and Joy.
obj.pulang: Enough for tonight. Go back home.

joy.1: Eh, Raka! When did you get back? I didn't get to wave when the bus passed earlier.
joy.2: I'm going to the field first, with this sack and a flashlight. I'll pass by again later. I'll hum a bit first, this road is quiet.

mak_yah.1: Eh, Raka! When did you come home, dear? You're all grown now.
mak_yah.2: Sit there. Want wrapped rice, hot tea, or just an old woman's gossip?
mak_yah.c2: Ask about Joy at the field.

kembali.1: Anything else, dear? Just treat it as gossip.

b05.tekan: Press a little further. Something might slip out.

topik_a.1: The fire? That one this month wasn't here, dear. The fire was at the field by the forest, not Joy's field.
topik_a.2: Folks said the smoke showed for two nights. Nobody got hurt, only the grass was gone. That was before you came home.
topik_a.3: That's the whole story. Want to know more?

tekan.1: People who saw it said it was just a red glow behind the trees. By morning it was all black.
tekan.2: Nobody is sure about the hour. People would rather sleep than be a witness.

topik_b.1: Joy guards a field held for a family. She lives alone in the hut near the forest.
topik_b.2: She isn't missing, dear. She just rarely comes out. Her father is sick in the city, so she was told to mind the field.
topik_b.3: She likes to hum while she works. At this hour she must already be at the field.

tekan.1: I told her, living at the edge of the forest like that is pitiful. She only laughed.
tekan.2: She said she likes being alone. Let her be, dear.

topik_c.1: Strangers? This week a black car stopped by the warung. Two men, thick jackets, nobody knew them.
topik_c.2: They asked for the road to the garden, paying with brand new bills. Pak Rudi walked with them.
topik_c.3: Alright, alright. Eat first, dear, before the rice gets cold.

tekan.1: They said they were hired to watch the garden at night. Paid per night, in cash.
tekan.2: I only heard it from someone else. Ask Rudi himself and he'll get angry.

selesai.1: Go home now, dear. Careful on the road, it's dark tonight.
selesai.2: Come by again some time. Don't only show up when you want to ask things.

nasi.1: I sit on the bench by the door. I order food first, so I don't look like I'm watching.

a.1: Chicken. I'll give you a bigger portion, you're too thin.

b.1: Yellow rice. You still like that one, don't you.

c.1: Hot tea. Keep your money, you can pay tomorrow.

warga.1: Two men at the far table talk quietly. Now and then they glance at me.
warga.2: Have you eaten, Ri? Don't go home alone, the road by the garden is dark.

radio.1: Dry weather until the end of the month. Residents are asked not to burn trash near the fields.
radio.2: The warung radio is always too loud. Tonight it carries all the way to the road.

keluar.1: I stand at the warung door. Far away, the field lights come on one by one.
keluar.2: Tonight is enough. I go home before my thoughts start running on their own.
